mechanism: Amikacin (aminoglycoside) carries ototoxic and nephrotoxic risk; tetrabenazine undergoes hepatic metabolism and may accumulate with renal impairment, while amikacin-induced nephrotoxicity could impair tetrabenazine clearance.
action: Monitor renal function, auditory function, and tetrabenazine levels; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antibiotics if possible; adjust tetrabenazine dosing based on renal status.
